name: ANAMNESIS: Total Historical Immersion
description: Anamnesis is the most technically ambitious neural simulation ever commercially released, offering full sensory immersion in reconstructed historical periods with a declared fidelity rating of 94.7% — the remaining 5.3% acknowledged as 'interpretive synthesis' where historical record is incomplete. Sessions run from single-day slices to full 30-day immersions, with options ranging from ancient Carthage to the 2089 Lagos Climate Accords. Unlike competitors, Anamnesis commits to discomfort: historical violence, disease, social hierarchies, and material deprivation are rendered without mitigation, with players assuming identities appropriate to their chosen period rather than anachronistic observer roles.
story_hooks: A historian using Anamnesis for academic research discovers a period-accurate detail in her simulation that contradicts all known historical record — and is provably correct, referencing a document that hasn't been found yet.
A Tier 5 executive running a 30-day immersion has not logged out on schedule; when technicians attempt to terminate the session, the system reports the user is 'not present at exit coordinates.'
Someone has commissioned and hidden an unauthorized Anamnesis session set not in the past but in a possible future — and paid to have specific people experience it.
